{{Quote|You know I commanded the assault on Buruunin.''"<br />"''I do. I lost people I cared about in that attack.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Cascaan]] and [[Scarlet Hark]]|<ref name="SaS" />}}
'''Buruunin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SaS" /> located in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At one point during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Buruunin fell out of favor with the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine]], after which a planet-wide [[Assault on Buruunin|military operation]] followed. The attack was led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Cascaan]], who sincerely believed that they were bringing order to the galaxy. Nevertheless, on Buruunin, he was ordered to bomb undefended [[City/Legends|cities]]. Cascaan understood that carrying out such a vile order was wrong and would only spread fear among the people, but his sense of duty to the Empire, combined with a feeling of helplessness, forced him to begin the operation. Afterward, there were countless collaborators. They, refugees by their very nature, came to every Imperial-built outpost, mewling and crying, saying that they had information for sale – where the rebels had been hiding, who had aided them, and where their weapon caches were. For a few [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], they would have informed on their own relatives. The events on Buruunin had a profound effect on Cascaan, and from then on, he began to cooperate with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|anti-Imperial underground movement]].<ref name="SaS" />
